mitigations: Upgrade to a fixed release and restart every PHP worker (php-fpm, Apache with mod_php, php-cgi, LiteSpeed, FrankenPHP). This is the only complete fix.
Interim, partial (CVE-2026-109619): set session.upload_progress.enabled=0, and on PHP 8.5 also fatal_error_backtraces=0. PHP states that no configuration change fully closes the vulnerability.
Interim, partial (CVE-2026-109618): set memory_limit=-1 so applications cannot override it, and enforce a container or cgroup memory limit as the availability boundary.
Stopgap only: restrict internet exposure of unpatched hosts and use WAF rules for known exploit vectors.
Exploitation was observed from 2026-10-17, before disclosure. Investigate for compromise from that date, not from the patch date.
